text:
nina: ApexCare returned their renewal security packet. Combined DPA + SOC2 questionnaire. Top asks: embeddings retention, BYOK availability per deployment, SOC2 evidence sharing, and whether we can offer residency guarantees tied to pricing. Need answers by EOD to avoid blocking renewal.

sam-cs: i'll draft the customer-facing bullets. quick facts from product: default embeddings retention = 90 days; deletions can be requested via API; tenant-separated and encrypted at rest.

sam-cs: one-liner draft for form: "Redwood retains customer-generated embeddings for up to 90 days by default. Customers may request earlier deletion via API or through their account team; Dedicated/Private customers can contract shorter or custom retention windows. See https://internal.redwood/docs/privacy/embeddings-retention."

ron-ops: ops note: for Dedicated/Private we can set retention during provisioning (30/90/365). provisioning flow: 1) CS specifies retention in ticket; 2) Ops sets retention config per-tenant; 3) verification and audit log enabled.

ron-ops: sample deletion endpoint to include: ```
DELETE /v1/customers/{id}/embeddings
Authorization: Bearer <token>
```

katie-legal: SOC2 guidance: we can provide SOC2 Type II under NDA. keep wording high-level in the questionnaire: "SOC2 Type II report available under NDA; specific evidence requests will be scoped and may require an elevated support path." avoid contractual promises in a questionnaire.

katie-legal: also replace any wording like "BYOK available" with "BYOK supported" to avoid implying SLA-level guarantees.

sam-cs: BYOK blurb (form): "BYOK supported on Dedicated and Private deployments. Hosted BYOK is available in scoped cases; contact your account team for details." added link to BYOK onboarding doc.

nina: thanks. can we add a quick ops config sample for Dedicated KMS binding? ApexCare will want the snippet to show it's doable.

ron-ops: paste sample: ```
{ "kms": { "provider": "aws", "key_id": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01" } }
```

ron-ops: also: rotation windows are agreed during onboarding; ops will confirm with customer and document in ticket.

sam-cs: finalizing doc with all lines. will keep legal-approved phrasing.

docbot: New doc created: https://internal.redwood/docs/dpa-answers/apexcare-1770007777 (view-only) :page_with_curl:

nina: schedule a 30m walkthrough tomorrow 11am PT to go over Dedicated BYOK and retention pilot? ron-ops can you join?

ron-ops: yes can do.

katie-legal: one more note for renewal: if ApexCare ties residency to price caps suggest proposing a 12-month Dedicated pilot with fixed pricing and SLA commitments documented in the commercial addendum.

nina: good call. i'll include the pilot option in the renewal proposal. sending answers now; follow-ups tracked in the shared doc. :rocket:

docbot: Shared doc updated: https://internal.redwood/docs/dpa-answers/apexcare-1770007777 (updated by sam-cs)

nina: done 680 - form sent to customer. leaving questions in the doc for any auditor follow-ups.
